newsitem.title: USA: WinStar Communications unit names new CFO.
newsitem.headline: WinStar Communications unit names new CFO.

text.p: WinStar Communications Inc said Friday it has appointed Ken Schwarz chief financial officer of its subsidiary, WinStar Telecommunications Inc, a local-exchange carrier.
The company also said it has appointed Jamie Bullen as vice president and chief information officer of the subsidiary.
Schwarz most recently was the senior vice president of marketing and customer satisfaction at Cable & Wireless Plc.
Bullen has been in charge of WinStar Telecommunication's software efforts.
WinStar Telecommunications plans to be in operation in all of WinStar's 41 licensed major markets over the next three years. Both appointments are for new positions.
